caption: The drawing depicts a metal lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top. The lantern is colored in various shades of brown and has visible areas of greenish patina, indicating aged metal. The body of the lantern is decorated with symmetrical punched patterns and rows of holes, allowing light to pass through. It features a small, rectangular hinged door on the side that is partly open, and this door also has a matching decorative pierced pattern. The top of the lantern has a looped handle for carrying or hanging, attached by a small metal fixture. There is also a circular ventilation hole near the top of the lantern, along with a small cylindrical piece attached to the upper side. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorations. The artist’s signature, "Oscar Bluemner," is visible at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Perforated Tin Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
